name: Rokushou Asuku
source:
Resident of Room 304. Due to his short temper, blunt remarks, and violent actions, he's got many enemies - both inside and outside the inn. He is belligerent and uses his favorite metal bat to attack others. While everyone agrees to have Hisora stay at the inn, he's the only person to oppose him and his unusual existence in the world.

[Source [URL=http://www.zombilica.com/games/nienomati/character.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
